cues.en: The other thing we said we wanted to consider was the release years of each movie.
cues.zh: 另一個想考慮的因素，是每部電影的上映年份。

cues.en: Extracting this from the MovieLens data is a little tricky, but the information we want is in the movie titles.
cues.zh: 從 MovieLens 資料擷取年份有點棘手，但所需資訊就在片名裡。

cues.en: They include the year at the end of every title, in parenthesis.
cues.zh: 每個片名最後，都以括號包含年份。

cues.en: So we just have to do a little bit a string wrangling in our code to extract that data.
cues.zh: 因此，只需要在程式碼中處理一下字串，就能擷取。

cues.en: How do we assign a similarity score based on release years alone?
cues.zh: 如何只根據上映年份，指定相似度分數？

cues.en: Well, this is where some of the art of recommender systems comes in.
cues.zh: 這就是推薦系統藝術成分發揮作用的地方。

cues.en: You have to think about the nature of the data you have and what makes sense.
cues.zh: 必須思考資料的本質，以及什麼樣的做法才合理。

cues.en: How far apart would two movies have to be for their release date alone to signify they are substantially different?
cues.zh: 兩部電影要相隔多久，才能光憑上映日期，就認為它們明顯不同？

cues.en: Well, a decade seems like a reasonable starting point.
cues.zh: 十年似乎是合理的起點。

cues.en: I mean, Sci-Fi movies in the 70's look pretty different from Sci-Fi movies in the 80's, for example.
cues.zh: 例如，1970 年代的科幻片，看起來與 1980 年代很不一樣。

cues.en: So, we want to start with the difference in release years for two movies, just the absolute value of the difference, it doesn't matter which one came first.
cues.zh: 因此，先計算兩部電影上映年份差的絕對值，不在乎哪一部先上映。

cues.en: Now we need to come up with some sort of mathematical function that smoothly scales that into the range zero to one.
cues.zh: 接著，需要某種數學函數，將它平滑地縮放到零到一之間。

cues.en: I chose an exponential decay function.
cues.zh: 我選擇指數衰減函數。

cues.en: It ends up looking like this.
cues.zh: 結果看起來像這樣。

cues.en: Just look at the right side of the graph, since we're taking the absolute values of the year differences which makes them all positive.
cues.zh: 只看圖的右半邊，因為年份差取絕對值，所以都變成正數。

cues.en: At a year difference of zero, we get a similarity score on the Y axis of one, which is what we want.
cues.zh: 年份差是零時，Y 軸的相似度是一，符合我們的需求。

cues.en: And this similarity score decays exponentially, getting pretty small at around a difference of 10 years and almost nothing at 20.
cues.zh: 這個相似度呈指數衰減，相差大約十年時已經相當小，相差二十年時幾乎為零。

cues.en: The choice of this function is completely arbitrary, but it seems like a reasonable starting point.
cues.zh: 選擇這個函數完全是主觀決定，但看起來是合理的起點。

cues.en: In the real world, you'd test many variations of this function to see what really produces the best recommendations with real people.
cues.zh: 真實世界中，會測試這個函數的許多變形，看看哪個真的能對真實使用者產生最好的推薦。

cues.en: So how do we turn these similarities between movies based on their attributes into actual rating predictions?
cues.zh: 如何把根據電影屬性算出的相似度，轉成實際的評分預測？

cues.en: Remember, our recommendation algorithms in surpriselib have one job, predict a rating for a given user for a given movie.
cues.zh: 記得，SurpriseLib 的推薦演算法只有一個任務：預測某位使用者對某部電影的評分。

cues.en: One way to do this is through a technique called k-nearest-neighbors.
cues.zh: 一種做法，是使用 k 最近鄰技術。

cues.en: Quite honestly, it's a unnecessarily fancy name for a really simple idea.
cues.zh: 老實說，這個名字對一個非常簡單的概念來說，有點太華麗了。

cues.en: We start by measuring the content-based similarity between everything a given user has rated, and the movie we want to predict a rating for.
cues.zh: 先衡量某位使用者評分過的所有電影，與待預測電影之間的內容式相似度。

cues.en: Next, we select some number, call it K, of the nearest-neighbors to the movie whose rating we're trying to predict.
cues.zh: 接著，為待預測的電影選出若干個最近鄰，將數量稱為 k。

cues.en: You can define nearest however you like, so in our case, we'll say the nearest-neighbors are the ones with the highest content-based similarity scores to the movie we're making a prediction for.
cues.zh: 你可以自行定義「最近」。在這裡，最近鄰就是與待預測電影的內容式相似度分數最高的項目。

cues.en: So, we could for example select the 40 movies whose genres and release dates most closely match the movie we want to evaluate for this user.
cues.zh: 例如，選出類型與上映日期，最接近待評估電影的 40 部電影。

cues.en: That's it, that's really all there is to the concept of k-nearest-neighbors.
cues.zh: 就是這樣，k 最近鄰的概念就這麼簡單。

cues.en: It's just selecting some number of things that are close to the thing you're interested in, that is, its neighbors, and predicting something about that item based on the properties of its neighbors.
cues.zh: 只是選出若干個接近目標的東西，也就是鄰居，再根據鄰居的特性，預測目標項目的某些資訊。

cues.en: So to turn these top 40 closest movies into an actual rating prediction, we can just take a weighted average of their similarity scores to the movie whose rating we're trying to predict,
cues.zh: 因此，要把最接近的 40 部電影轉成實際評分預測，可以對它們與待預測電影的相似度，取加權平均，

cues.en: weighting them by the rating the user gave them.
cues.zh: 並以使用者給它們的評分加權。

cues.en: That's all there is to it.
cues.zh: 就這麼簡單。

cues.en: Let's turn that concept into code.
cues.zh: 將這個概念轉成程式碼。

cues.en: This is the meaty part of our prediction function, which takes in a user, U, and an item, I, that we want to predict a rating for.
cues.zh: 這是預測函數的核心，接受使用者 u，以及要預測評分的項目 i。

cues.en: We start with a list called neighbors, and go through every movie the user has rated, populating it with a content-based similarity score between each movie and the movie we're trying to predict.
cues.zh: 先建立名為 neighbors 的串列，走訪使用者評分過的每部電影，填入各電影與待預測電影之間的內容式相似度分數。

cues.en: We pre-computed those similarity scores in the self.similarities array.
cues.zh: 這些相似度，已經預先計算並存在 self.similarities 陣列中。

cues.en: Next, we use heapq.nlargest to quickly and easily sort that list into the top-K movies with the highest similarity scores to the movie in question.
cues.zh: 接著，使用 heapq.nlargest，快速輕鬆地從清單選出與目標電影相似度最高的前 k 部電影。

cues.en: After that, it's just a matter of computing the weighted average of the top-K similar movies, weighted by the ratings the user gave them.
cues.zh: 然後，只要計算前 k 部相似電影的加權平均，以使用者給它們的評分加權。

cues.en: Assuming we had some data to work with there, we return that as our rating prediction for this user and item.
cues.zh: 假設確實有可用資料，就把結果當成這位使用者對這個項目的評分預測傳回。

cues.en: So let's actually play around and run this thing, and generate some real recommendations just using content-based filtering.
cues.zh: 接著實際操作、執行它，只使用內容式過濾，產生真正的推薦。

cues.en: We're just going to recommend movies that are similar to movies each user liked, based only on their genre and release date.
cues.zh: 我們只根據類型與上映日期，推薦與每位使用者喜愛電影相似的電影。

cues.en: Let's see how well that actually works.
cues.zh: 看看實際效果如何。
